description: Two businesses side by side by slug. Returns a brief for each (tier, category, annualized revenue + basis, pricing model, founded, top 2 lessons, growth series) and a diff (annualized_a, annualized_b, ratio a/b, same_category, same_tier). Example: {"a":"cursor","b":"lovable"} -> Cursor vs Lovable with the revenue ratio. Cost: free, 100 tools/call per day without a key (API keys from $9/mo raise the limit). Over the free 100/day: $0.005 per call via x402 (no signup).
name: compare_businesses
